claims: The 12 zodiac signs are determined by the sun's position at birth.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Aries spans March 21–April 19.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Aries is Fire.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Taurus spans April 20–May 20.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Taurus is Earth.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Gemini spans May 21–June 20.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Gemini is Air.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Cancer spans June 21–July 22.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Cancer is Water.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Leo spans July 23–August 22.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Leo is Fire.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Virgo spans August 23–September 22.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Virgo is Earth.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Libra spans September 23–October 22.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Libra is Air.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Scorpio spans October 23–November 21.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Scorpio is Water.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Sagittarius spans November 22–December 21.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Sagittarius is Fire.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Capricorn spans December 22–January 19.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Capricorn is Earth.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Aquarius spans January 20–February 18.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Aquarius is Air.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Pisces spans February 19–March 20.
In Tropical/Western Astrology, Pisces is Water.
Fire signs are Aries, Leo, Sagittarius.
Earth signs are Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn.
Air signs are Gemini, Libra, Aquarius.
Water signs are Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces.
Cardinal signs are Aries, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn.
Fixed signs are Taurus, Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius.
Mutable signs are Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Pisces.
A video from The New York Times explains that astronomical, or actual, constellations do not perfectly align with the traditional 12-sign, 12-month calendar system used in astrology.
